scripts.build: npm run build:pricing && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:pricing && vitest run && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:pricing && concurrently -n api,web --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test
